anomalies.observed: The root sheet contains a powered 2-input logic gate (drawn as an XOR gate) with labels TROI_XOR_A, TROI_XOR_B, and TROI_XOR_Y. TROI_XOR_A is connected to ESP32 GPIO9 on the MCU sheet, and TROI_XOR_B is connected to thermocouple input wiring on the Thermocouples sheet (appearing on MAX31855 input nets such as U2 pin 2 / U3 pin 3). TROI_XOR_Y is not connected to any MCU input, actuator, or other load.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes no logic gate and no TROI_XOR nets. The thermocouple inputs are intended to connect only to the MAX31855 T+/T- pins, and the MCU pins listed for this subsystem are GPIO5/GPIO10 for SCK/SO and GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 for CS0/CS1/CS2; GPIO9 is not part of the described architecture.

evidence.quote: controller.kicad_sch root sheet: gate symbol with labels "TROI_XOR_A", "TROI_XOR_B", "TROI_XOR_Y"
Reads up to 3 K-type thermocouples ... over a shared SPI bus (SCK/SO + 3 independent chip-selects CS0–CS2)

anomalies.impact: An unintended powered logic gate is tied into a MCU GPIO and thermocouple sensing node(s). This can load or corrupt thermocouple measurements and creates an undefined connection to GPIO9, causing behavior that differs from the specified controller design.

anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet, the +12V rail is connected to both pins 1 and 2 of each 4-pin fan header J7 and J8.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists only the pin-2 pins of J7/J8 on the +12V net. Standard 4-pin fan headers use pin 1 as ground, so pin 1 should not be driven from +12V.

evidence.quote: power.kicad_sch: "+12V" connected to J7 pins 1 and 2 and J8 pins 1 and 2
the two fan-header 12 V pins (`J7`/`J8` pin 2)

anomalies.impact: If a standard 4-pin fan is connected, its ground pin would be shorted to +12V, preventing normal fan operation and potentially damaging the fan or board; fan tach fault detection would also become unreliable.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains an unexpected powered XOR/TROI_XOR network tied to MCU GPIO9 and thermocouple input nets, which is not present in the specification. A secondary concern is that +12V appears on fan header pin 1 as well as pin 2, contrary to the specified fan-header wiring and standard fan-header practice.
